reason: I only put paint on my walls from brands I see on TV and can ask for by name, and Turbolux is a Kerala brand I have never heard of that has only just arrived in Kochi. For a full repaint I would rather call the big brand's own painting service, even if it costs a bit more.
objection: Who are these painters really? 'Turbolux-trained' could just mean some local subcontractor, and once they have my money and there is bubbling after the next monsoon, will anyone pick up the phone? A new brand has no track record I can check, and I can't have an unreliable crew breaking my building's contractor hours.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three finished flats in Kakkanad that they painted at least one monsoon ago, with the owners vouching for it, plus a written guarantee with a named Turbolux contact who actually answers.
